heroDecision: The owner approved matching jobs and career profiles as the two main purposes, including useful profiles when no suitable vacancy is open. Keep local CLI and MCP explicit and setup simple for Codex and Claude Code. An explicit Run authorizes selected actions; profile outcomes are separate from confirmed applications. This is an owner decision, not measured conversion evidence. The default native workflow hands the saved request to the existing selected client; Tawdheef does not launch another model.

operatingBoundaries.localClient: The actual selected Codex or Claude Code client owns the model and all external tools. Tawdheef supplies local guidance, scoped records and copied handoffs; no installed assistant CLI or app-launched assistant subprocess is required in native mode. Browser ChatGPT/Claude chats do not read local stdio configuration.
operatingBoundaries.authorization: Only an explicit named Run authorizes its saved selected application, profile or CV-sharing actions and targets. Sign-ins, CAPTCHA, provider approvals and LinkedIn steps may need the person. Stop revokes local authority; stop remaining work in the external client too.
operatingBoundaries.cv: Public directory research and manual tracking need no Tabbio account or CV. Before matching or submitting, the actual client must read the real authorized CV. Tawdheef does not gate a native handoff on a CLI/CV probe or cache the native CV. Editing, publishing or visibility changes require their own request.
operatingBoundaries.costs: Tawdheef code is free and MIT licensed. The user's AI client, model use and connected providers may have separate costs or limits.
operatingBoundaries.outcomes: Record real receipts/confirmations, inspect unknown submissions before retrying, and keep accounts, profiles, uploads, CV sends, talent pools and applied outcomes separate.
operatingBoundaries.connections: Native is the default: Tabbio MCP/CV, email, calendar, browser/computer and password manager belong to the actual client. Connection reports are dated client observations, not independent verification. App-owned adapters and credentials remain only in explicitly selected Advanced compatibility.
operatingBoundaries.monitoring: Only requested read-only monitoring uses the actual client’s supported local automation and tools for bounded source/account reads. Saving preferences, copying a request or recording a task ID does not create or independently verify a schedule. Monitoring grants no applying, profile/CV-sharing, sending or calendar-write authority.
